senses.sense_definition: A small rodent often kept as a pet or used in scientific research.

senses.sense_definition: Any of various Old World rodent species belonging to the subfamily Cricetinae.

senses.sense_definition: To secretly store or hoard items, similar to how a rodent stores food in its cheeks.
